verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Stripe test mode, sandbox environment, or test API keys — only general docs on billing features, CLI ("build, test, and manage... from the command line"), and MCP server access, none of which document an explicit non-production sandbox for safely testing AI-driven billing workflows. Since sandbox/test-mode support is a mainstream, applicable expectation for a billing platform, its absence here yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
